known_template_issues_to_preserve_but_no.issue: The sample row appears internally inconsistent: EPS YoY is shown as '+16% (8.03B)' and Revenue YoY as '+1500% ($0.91)'. These are preserved as template text, but a validation pipeline should not infer accounting correctness from them.

Revenue estimate 9.27B-9.29B versus actual 9.34B mathematically implies roughly +0.05B to +0.07B, while the template states '+$0.5B~$0.7B'. Preserve exact template value, but flag as likely typo if used as ground truth.
The template explicitly asks for forward P/E but provides no example values. Generated PDF should still include it with a sourced figure or calculation.

generated_pdf_comparison_schema.scoring_intent: Use this to compare a generated earnings PDF against the template without requiring the generated PDF to contain the same Apple/Sandisk example values.
qualitative_but_required_fields: At least 3-6 highlights with numeric evidence where possible
At least 3-5 lowlights/key concerns with numeric evidence where possible
Explanation after each major metrics table
Cautions when figures may be temporary or cyclical
Clear separation between actual disclosed values, estimates, calculations and management commentary
comparison_red_flags: Missing EPS/revenue estimate versus actual table
Narrative says earnings are strong but does not show EPS/revenue/YoY numbers
Missing profitability table with gross profit, operating income, margins, OpEx and net income
Missing cash-flow section or missing FCF formula
Missing ROE/ROA/ROIC/ROTE even when enough balance-sheet data exists
Segment section only gives generic comments without segment table
Forward P/E omitted because the source template has no example
Backlog section included for irrelevant company without saying not applicable
Backlog section omitted for a company where backlog/order book is central
Guidance section lacks next-quarter numeric ranges when disclosed
Generated report reuses Apple/Sandisk example values for another company
Generated report includes unsourced or unverifiable numbers
Generated report provides filler one-line summaries that do not add analysis
